summary.text: Brian Harrison is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 10 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He assumed office on October 12, 2021, and faces Democrat Michael Myers in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Brian Harrison lives in Midlothian, Texas, graduated from Ovilla Christian School and earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 2004, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working for his family's construction business, serving as chief of staff to former U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Alex Azar under President Donald Trump, and co-founding and co-operating a business.
Harrison advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Criminal Jurisprudence and Public Education committees.
His campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, lists border security, protecting the unborn, Second Amendment rights and national security among his priorities.
